params.body:
The same run (`good-governance#24`, sportbusinessgame) was misjudged twice today: first against a reading from before the merge (elixir#199), then against one that read the redirect hop instead of the page behind it (elixir#203). The first correction fitted in `wasVerdict`; the second was refused, because one field holds one withdrawal, and the record kept a verdict everybody knew to be wrong.

`withdrawals` is a list now: every verdict that was passed keeps its evidence, its reason and its moment, and the run returns to `unjudged` each time so the next reading decides it. A withdrawal without a reason is still refused.

After merging, on the box:

```
php artisan elixir:ledger-withdraw headers https://github.com/ShaneDeconinck/good-governance/pull/24 --reason="judged on a reading that followed the redirect hop instead of the page behind it; fixed in elixir#203, and the site sends all four"
php artisan elixir:judge headers
```

653 tests, PHPStan, Pint.
params.title: A withdrawal is a history, not a field
